name: discover_fighorse
description: Call this first. Returns fighorse's self-description, Figma replication workflow, input/output contracts, and recommended tool order.

name: check_fighorse_ready
description: Check whether fighorse is ready to call Figma APIs, including runtime and token presence. Does not call Figma. If auth.has_token is false, tell the user to run `fighorse auth login --token <FIGMA_TOKEN>` or set FIGMA_TOKEN before calling Figma API tools.

name: parse_figma_url
description: Parse a pasted Figma URL into file_key/node_id or browser_root_id/team_id/project_id plus machine-readable url_role, catalog_eligible, design_target, next_action, and stable error_code such as browser_root_not_enumerable. Team and project browser URLs are catalog sources, not design targets.

figma_url.description: Figma design/file/proto/board URL, files/team/project browser URL, or raw file key

name: get_resource_catalog
description: Build a read-only catalog of all accessible projects, files, branches, and optionally published team library resources from a Figma team/project browser URL or explicit ID. Returns ready, partial, or blocked with structured permission diagnostics.

figma_url.description: Figma team or project browser URL.

team_id.description: Explicit team ID when no URL is available.

project_id.description: Explicit project ID when no URL is available.

include_libraries.description: Include paginated team components, component sets, and styles. Default true.

probe_file_access.description: Probe files sequentially at depth 1. Default false.

max_probes.description: Maximum depth-1 file probes. Default 25; 0 means unlimited.

name: get_replicate_workflow
description: Return the self-learning workflow for recreating Figma designs with fighorse.

name: get_experience_schema
description: Return the versioned local experience schema. Call this before recording reusable Figma replication lessons.

name: list_experiences
description: Return prompt-ready local lessons relevant to a target platform, asset format, category, or tag. Call before implementation and after mismatches.

platform.description: Target platform/framework, e.g. android-compose, ios-swiftui, web-react, flutter

scope.description: Experience scope: auto, global, project, or merged

name: record_experience
description: Append a reusable local lesson from a Figma replication run. This does not mutate Figma; it teaches future fighorse calls.

platform.description: Target platform/framework, e.g. android-compose, ios-swiftui, web-react, flutter

evidence.description: What happened: screenshot diff, build error, overlap, etc.

recommendation.description: Action AI should take next time

scope.description: Experience write scope: auto, global, project, or merged

client.description: AI client, e.g. cursor, codex, kimi-cli, opencode

command.description: CLI command or MCP tool related to the lesson

name: get_design_package
description: Best default tool for AI design replication. Accepts a Figma URL and returns compact structure, tokens, screenshots, assets, implementation hints, and scope. If scope.status is needs_narrowing for SECTION/CANVAS/DOCUMENT containers, choose a screen_candidates item with implementable=true and call get_design_package again. diagnostics.screenshots.null_count means Figma returned null render URLs.

file_key.description: Raw Figma file key when no URL is available.

node_id.description: Optional Figma node ID in API form, e.g. 376:5412. URL node-id is parsed automatically.

max_tokens.description: Approximate token budget for compact context. Default 8000.

include_assets.description: Include image fill asset URLs. Default false.

platform.description: Target platform/framework, e.g. android-compose, ios-swiftui, web-react, flutter. Ask the developer if unknown.

asset_format.description: Preferred export format for local slices/assets, e.g. png, svg, jpg, pdf, webp.

name: visual_audit
description: Build a structured visual audit checklist for a Figma URL and optional implementation screenshot.

name: get_project_playbook
description: Return a project-level fighorse implementation playbook assembled from guidance, API coverage, and local experience.

name: parse_code_connect_template
description: Normalize modern Code Connect documents supplied directly as JSON. Does not read, write, or execute project template files.

name: validate_code_connect
description: Validate Code Connect documents against Figma component nodes. Sends node IDs to Figma but not template code.

name: preview_code_connect
description: Render Code Connect snippets through Figma's observed preview protocol. Requires FIGHORSE_MCP_CODE_CONNECT=allow because template code is sent to Figma.

name: get_design_context
description: Get compact AI-oriented design context for a Figma file.

name: get_node
description: Get a specific node from a Figma file.

name: get_tokens
description: Extract design tokens from a Figma file.

name: get_screenshot
description: Render a node screenshot. Alias of get_images for one or more node IDs.

name: export_images
description: Download rendered node slices to local files. Uses safe filenames and can write manifest.json for AI/build-tool discovery.

dest_dir.description: Output directory. Default ./.fighorse/exports. Must stay under ./.fighorse/exports, ./assets/fighorse, or ~/.fighorse/exports.

name: export_component
description: Download a Figma component/control node as an image slice. Alias of export_images.

dest_dir.description: Output directory. Default ./.fighorse/exports. Must stay under ./.fighorse/exports, ./assets/fighorse, or ~/.fighorse/exports.

name: download_image_fills
description: Download all image fills in a Figma file to local files. Adds file extensions from content type and can write manifest.json.

dest_dir.description: Output directory. Default ./.fighorse/exports. Must stay under ./.fighorse/exports, ./assets/fighorse, or ~/.fighorse/exports.

name: get_comment_reactions
description: Get reactions for a comment.

name: get_team_component_sets
description: Get published component sets in a team.

name: get_component_set
description: Get a component set by key.

name: get_webhook
description: Get a webhook by ID.

name: get_team_webhooks
description: Get webhooks for a team. Deprecated by Figma but kept for REST parity.

name: get_webhook_requests
description: Get recent requests for a webhook.

name: get_activity_logs
description: Get organization activity logs.

name: get_developer_logs
description: Get organization developer logs.

name: get_payments
description: Get payments.

name: get_oembed
description: Get Figma oEmbed data.

name: get_library_analytics_component_usages
description: Get component usage analytics.

name: get_library_analytics_component_actions
description: Get component action analytics.

name: get_library_analytics_style_actions
description: Get style action analytics.

name: get_library_analytics_style_usages
description: Get style usage analytics.

name: get_library_analytics_variable_usages
description: Get variable usage analytics.

name: get_library_analytics_variable_actions
description: Get variable action analytics.
